name: Paella-lite chicken & prawn rice
steps: Brown the diced chicken in olive oil with the smoked paprika.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes, and a pinch of saffron until coated.
Pour in hot stock and simmer gently without stirring for fifteen minutes.
Nestle the prawns and peas on top and cook until the prawns turn pink.
Rest off the heat for five minutes, then serve with lemon.
